clean_body: A former Guardsman on the dangerous line this administration erased. | | Peter, One week ago today, American soldiers on patrol in an American city shot and killed an American citizen. He was 20 years old. A young father named Tyrin Johnson. Circumstances leading up to the event are unclear. Tyrin's family disputes the official line from the White House, and no video evidence has been released. But regardless of what led to the shooting, one thing is clear: We are on a very dangerous path to martial law, and Congress is letting it happen. We have a law in this country called thePosse Comitatus Act , and it was written to keep soldiers out of the business of policing American citizens. This tragedy in Memphis is the exact thing that law was built to prevent, and it happened because this administration and loyalists like Keith Self keep ignoring the Constitution. Last fall, the governor of Tennessee promised these Guard soldiers would not be armed and would not be taking law enforcement calls. He lied on both accounts. There are now troubling reports that the Guard is not only answering law enforcement calls but in some cases, like this one, arriving at the scene before local police do as they did here. As a combat aviator and former member of the Connecticut and California Air National Guard, I know a soldier and a police officer do two very different jobs. Blurring those lines is how free countries get into trouble. Guardsmen are your neighbors. They are the guy who fixes your transmission, the woman who teaches your kids in school. They train for hurricanes and wildfires and floods, for the day the levee breaks and folks need somebody to show up - keep order and get people to safety. Guardsmen are not meant nor trained to walk a beat and make split-second decisions about deadly force. But this authoritarian administration put troops on American streets for the show of it, and MAGA sycophants like Greg Abbott and Keith Self (my opponent) have let it happen. Now a 20-year-old father is dead because of that choice. Trump and the men who enabled him own this, and they are counting on nobody in Congress caring enough to say so. Congress has a duty to shut these illegal deployments down and that starts with flipping Congress this fall. ## Bitcoin Was the Prototype
Say what you want about Bitcoin — it proved something the experts swore was impossible. It proved that millions of people want a way to store wealth that no government can print, freeze, or inflate away. That idea was radical in 2009. Today it's a trillion-dollar fact. But here's what the true believers don't like to admit: Bitcoin got the _idea_ right and the _backing_ wrong. It's backed by nothing but belief. It can lose a third of its value in a month. And it consumes as much electricity as a small country just to keep the lights on. It was the prototype. A brilliant, world-changing prototype — but a prototype all the same. So here's the question worth sitting with: what happens when someone takes everything Bitcoin got right — the digital freedom, the scarcity, the independence from any government — and fixes the one thing it got wrong, by backing it with real, verified gold? You get the finished version. And it starts trading on Kraken on **July 8**. And to be clear: this isn't another speculative crypto, and it isn't paper gold. It's backed by real, certified, in-ground gold — the gold stays right where it is, and the value trades. I'm not going to unpack the whole thing in an email. name: Gretchen Whitmer
subject: Why I fight like hell — and I hope you will too
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Fight Like Hell PAC
body:
When people count you out, you show up anyway. |
#
---
Team — When I first ran for office, a lot of people told me not to do it. Some said I was too young. Others said the timing wasn’t right. More than a few told me that a woman couldn’t win. But I knew why I was running. I believed in what I stood for, and I refused to let cynicism make decisions for me. I’ve never forgotten that feeling, which is why I believe so deeply in the work of Fight Like Hell PAC. Because every day, there are people out there who are told the same things I once was. That they’re not the right fit. That politics is broken. That it’s just not worth it. **But it _is_ worth it.** Public service matters. Good things happen when the right people say yes. And we’ve seen the cost when they don’t. That’s why we’re working to bring new people into this fight. We’re helping everyday folks step into leadership, connect with their communities, and build the tools they need to run — and win. I know it can be tempting to give up or tune out, especially in the moment we find ourselves in. But the truth is, **progress only happens when we decide to show up anyway. ** **[If you believe that too, I hope you’ll consider making a donation today. Peter,
A new blatantly illegal scheme by Trump to rig the upcoming midterm elections just dropped. And this one has the potential to be deadly if states don't comply.
FEMA is now threatening to withhold federal grants for terrorism prevention to states that don't comply with a list of election related demands. They are demanding states switch to paper ballots, use the federal "SAVE" database to purge voter rolls, and to conduct background checks of all election related workers to verify citizenship status.

The requirement to use the federal "SAVE" database to purge voter rolls is particularly illegal. Just weeks ago, a federal judge ordered the Trump administration to immediately end and delete the database, citing a "major violation" of American's privacy rights. It was also revealed in that court case that the database was wrongfully purging Democratic voters from the voter rolls.
Trump has significantly ramped up his election rigging attempts in recent weeks. FBI raids against voter rights organizations, USPS threatening to not deliver mail-in ballots in blue states, a renewed push to get the Senate to pass the most restrictive voting law in American history.
He's desperately throwing everything he has at the wall in hopes that something will stick--and that he can get the right judge to greenlight it.
That's why Defend Our Courts is leading a multifront counterassault against Trump's election rigging schemes. First, we are building a firewall of state Supreme Courts with the power to protect free and fair elections, state by state. body:
[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1001&akid=7679%2E582294%2EGn66di ]Chris Pappas for Senate[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/126?t=1002&akid=7679%2E582294%2EGn66di ]Chris Pappas for Senate

I need to be direct with you: Polling shows our lead is
slipping.

[ TIED ]TIED New Hampshire Senate Race: Sununu: 44%, Pappas: 45%

National Republicans are pouring in cash and surging to try to flip this
seat, and it’s working.

This is a reminder of how close this race really is – and how quickly
momentum can shift when outside spending ramps up.

The path to the Senate runs through New Hampshire, and the GOP knows it.

If Democrats are going to have any chance of taking back the majority, we
have to match their energy right now to organize, communicate, and ensure
we’re reaching every single voter between now and Election Day.

If you’re looking for the right moment to join this grassroots movement,
this is it. We are counting on your support to fight back against the GOP
and gather the resources we need to be successful in November. [ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260712_2.ZL5hXT&refcode=em20260712-2&t=1003&akid=7679%2E582294%2EGn66di ]Will you
chip in $5 today?

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260712_2.ZL5hXT&amount=5&refcode=em20260712-2&t=1022&akid=7679%2E582294%2EGn66di ]Donate $5 »

John Sununu has made it clear he’ll stand with Donald Trump and protect
his agenda in the Senate. And right now, we’re tied.

If Republicans win here in New Hampshire, it will cement a MAGA Senate
majority for years to come – and give Trump unchecked power in Washington.

I’ve taken on tough fights before, and I know we can win this one, too.
But only if we have the resources to fight back immediately. [ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260712_2.ZL5hXT&refcode=em20260712-2&t=1023&akid=7679%2E582294%2EGn66di ]Will you

[ https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260712_2.ZL5hXT&amount=5&refcode=em20260712-2&t=1042&akid=7679%2E582294%2EGn66di ]Donate $5 »

Our next steps will decide whether we can keep up, respond to attacks, and
reach the voters we need to win. I’m counting on your grassroots support.

Thanks for being with me,

Chris

_**by Cliff Schecter**_
Lindsey Graham spent Friday in Kyiv, shaking Volodymyr Zelenskyy's hand on his tenth wartime visit to Ukraine. He spent Saturday evening on the phone with Donald Trump. By Sunday morning he was dead at 71, and Trump was on Truth Social telling the world it "could've been his last call"--because of course the unholiest, emptiest, piss-sack-of-a-man has to even make others' obituaries about Donald Trump.
There it is, folks. Graham's whole career in thirty-six hours.
One of best things he ever did, honoring his onetime posture as a serious man who understood and fought for crucial international relationships and institutions. And the newer, lesser Lindsey. The one who couldn't wait to call his prom date afterwards, for what became one last low-minded conversation with the gaudy, jingoistic jester to whom he ultimately sold his stature and legacy the last decade of his life.
The first in line with the far-from-perfect, but-at-times useful moderate-conservative he was (see his onetime push for immigration reform, #MeToo legislation, and more). The other, soulless, MAGA-adjacent jackal talking to Trump about God only knows what.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2d1faae2-28e2-4d2a-a80b-bdc063e2ebd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Stacked back to back like a closing argument.
I'm not going to pretend to grieve, and I'm not going to dance, either. A man died suddenly at 71, and the people who loved him deserve their mourning. But Graham was a United States senator for twenty-three years, and senators get judged, not eulogized, by the likes of me. So let's judge.
## Which Lindsey Are We Burying?
The thing about Lindsey Graham (R-Wherever You Need Him to Be) is that there was never one of him. Washington's oldest running joke was asking which Lindsey would show up that day, and the answer was always the same: _it depended on the wind_.
December 2015, on CNN: Donald Trump was a "race-baiting, xenophobic, religious bigot." May 2016, on Twitter:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2d1faae2-28e2-4d2a-a80b-bdc063e2ebd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Seven periods in that ellipse. Count 'em--that's how sure he was of his proclamation. Then Trump won, and Lindsey discovered that the bigot had a lovely golf swing and an open seat on the cart. One trip to the golf course and Lindsey was all in. There was speculation it was kompromat--the Russians did hack RNC servers in 2016, they just never released those emails like they did those of former Secretary of State and Democratic presidential candidate, Hillary Rodham Clinton.
And if we're going to be honest--and that's my belief in these situations--there were longtime rumors Graham was gay, which followed him as closely as he once followed Senator John McCain. I obviously couldn't care less, as long as his personal need for secrets didn't undermine national security secrets. I don't need to know _the why_ of what made this mouse-y, oleaginous, camera-loving man act so oft-disingenuous in recent years. I just know he did, and with it wrecked any respectable place for him in history's telling of this age, following the decade-long tradition of #ETTD, or _Everything Trump Touches Dies_.
In 2016, while helping strangle Merrick Garland's nomination in the crib, he begged us:
> I want you to use my words against me. If there's a Republican president in 2016 and a vacancy occurs in the last year of the first term, you can say Lindsey Graham said let's let the next president, whoever it might be, make that nomination.
Ruth Bader Ginsburg died forty-six days before the 2020 election. Graham rammed Amy Coney Barrett through the Judiciary Committee and onto the Court _eight days_ before Election Day, with millions of ballots already cast. Without a hint of irony or apology--but the honesty you'd find in an email from a Nigerian prince stranded on a road near Abuja, 100% ready to wire you a quick million if you send him $100 and share your bank account.
And don't forget your Social Security number so he can make the payment!
This is all to say _we used Lindsey 's words against him_. Turned out words were never the point.
In November of 2020 he personally called Brad Raffensperger--Georgia's Republican secretary of state. Graham had no earthly business calling as the senior senator from _South Carolina_ about Georgia's ballots--and Raffensperger came away from the call saying Graham had floated tossing legally cast mail ballots. _Read that again: Graham wanted Raffensberger to erase your vote --your constitutional inheritance in this country--so his dominatrix Donald would be pleased._
Let's put it in plain English: Lindsey, a man for whom fainting couches were seemingly invented for his drama-soaked, tears-of-a-clown routines--like the one he performed for paragon of integrity, Brett Kavanaugh--was a-ok stealing an election for Donald Trump. Graham said that's not what he meant. It never was, with Lindsey. (And be sure to never forget poor, suffering Brett, forced to endure as women he allegedly assaulted were allowed to tell their stories in public hearings).
Meanwhile, Lindsey never that tweet. It just sat there like a time capsule of a better time. And less confused of a man:
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/dc486f2d-0b6a-46be-a495-44d9aff852b1?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Then there was January 6, 2021, from the Senate floor. Lindsey being Lindsey. Where he previously zigged, now zagged: "Count me out. Enough is enough." As in, he was finally donning his galoshes to climb out of the giant shit-pit he'd chosen to inhabit with the traitor Trump.
That conviction had the shelf life of of a Graham Platner candidacy. Within weeks he was back at Mar-a-Lago kissing Trump's rather bulbous, bloated arse. _And by 2024,_ _he was endorsing the guy he blamed for a coup attempt against the United States of America_.
And through it all, the ghost at the edge of the frame was John McCain. Graham spent two decades as McCain's wingman--the closest he ever got to conviction. Trump claimed McCain wasn't a war hero because he got captured. Yet Graham watched this bone-spurred, feral hog spit in his best friend's face, and later on his grave (in 2019, after McCain had passed away, Trump ordered the USS John McCain "out of sight" during a state visit to Japan, where it was stationed).
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/2d1faae2-28e2-4d2a-a80b-bdc063e2ebd3?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
From that.......Graham concluded the smart play was to carry Trump's golf bag.
Also, if you'll indulge me for a second, as someone who wrote a book on John McCain ("The Real McCain"). I found a lot to criticize about the man as a politician. Even as a person. But I always, _and I mean always_ , defended his honor as a soldier. A soldier _who chose to remain in captivity and endure God-only-knows-how-much-more torture_ , because when the Vietnamese discovered McCain's famous name (both his grandfather and father had been/were highly decorated U.S. Navy Admirals) they wanted to release him, and only him. He told them to shove it, he wasn't leaving without his men.
In other words, _this critic_ of John McCain more vociferously defended his military honor than his onetime great friend. If you want a single image of what happened to the Republican Party, that's the one.

## Credit Where It's Due--and I Mean It
Now we continue with my earlier promise. Honesty...

I’ve spent my career studying facts. Literally.
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?]
As a microbiologist, I’ve dedicated my life to understanding the world through evidence, experimentation, and truth. But lately, it feels like those values are on life support in DC.
Politicians are spreading misinformation faster than any virus I’ve ever studied — denying science, rewriting history, and silencing the experts who could help us solve our biggest challenges.
That’s why I’m running for Congress — to make sure truth and science have a seat at the table again.
If elected, I would be the first woman with a STEM PhD EVER to serve in Congress.
Think about that: In the entire history of this country, no woman scientist has ever had a vote in our nation’s legislature. That is not acceptable. It is time to change that!
But to do it, I need your help. Republicans would rather elect extremist yes-men who are backed by corporate PACs and far-right groups — they’re terrified of a woman scientist holding them accountable. But I’m powered by grassroots support — people like you who believe facts still matter.
Will you chip in right now to help me make history and send a scientist to Congress? [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/jc_dsg-em?]

Patriot,

There's a deep divide in the Democratic Party.

**" We're worse off than 2016...**

Hi Peter, it’s Mark.
Mail-in voting has been all over the news recently. Here’s why it matters.
SCOTUS upheld the longstanding principle that late-arriving mail-in ballots should be counted towards election results - a huge win for our democracy.
For active-duty servicemembers, veterans, and military families, mail-in voting isn't a convenience. It's how many of them exercise their constitutional right to vote while serving our country.
And as I publicly stated, defending our country and the right to vote _must_ _never_ be mutually exclusive:
---
[|
---](https://us.list-manage.com/E7N2pDSwt3a?e=9a636fd341&c2id=ae98f6cf43ea0068f4a73fa64a1c3f9c)
| |
**This win is huge, but the fight is far from over.**
Within hours of the decision, Donald Trump was already calling on Speaker Mike Johnson and congressional Republicans to revive the SAVE Act—legislation that critics argue would make it significantly harder for many eligible Americans to register and vote.
I’m fighting tooth and nail to ensure that the SAVE America Act never sees the light of day, but I count on my supporters like you to help.

Every day I meet Michiganders who are doing everything right. They're working hard, raising families, building businesses, and giving back to their communities. But for too many people, hard work alone isn't enough to keep up with the rising cost of everyday life.
Whether it's groceries, gas, housing, or prescription drugs, the math just isn't adding up. Families working full time shouldn't have to wonder if they'll have enough left over at the end of the month to pay the mortgage. **Yet recent research shows that nearly 40% of working Michiganders are living paycheck to paycheck, barely surpassing the cost of survival threshold**.
This isn't the future I'm willing to accept for Michiganders.
Living paycheck to paycheck means that too many Michiganders are forced to make impossible choices every single day. There are working Michiganders who have to choose between paying for gas to drive to work every day and keeping the AC on in the summer and mothers who have to choose between groceries and school lunches or refilling prescriptions.
I'm running for Senate because I love the people of Michigan. They deserve prices and paychecks that allow them to _live_ and not just barely survive.
**There 's one thing that differentiates me from the rest of my opponents: I'm the only non-millionaire in this race.** A millionaire in Michigan won't understand what it's like to decide which basic necessities have to be sacrificed to get by. They never have to do the mental math to figure out what they can and can't afford each week. Another millionaire in the Senate means another lawmaker who sees inflated gas prices, shrugs their shoulders, and says "we're fine."
**There are 73 millionaires in the Senate - we don't need a 74th.**
Michigan deserves a leader who will fight rising costs because they actually know what rising costs mean. You deserve a leader who has delivered for you. I've confronted corporations and lowered prescription drug costs, created manufacturing jobs across the state, fought for affordable housing, and dedicated my career to ensuring that our government works for Michiganders.
I'm in the best position to be able to help the Michigan families most impacted by increasing costs. When the cost of survival, let alone the cost of living, is a number that feels unattainable to 40% of our state, it means it's time to step up and fight back against rising costs.
While I lead the charge for change, I just have one ask from you because I want to know what matters most to you: **[Will you fill out my campaign survey so I can hear directly from you?](https://substack.com/redirect/52b8afda-0877-432a-9b9c-f906734c63a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**
[ Survey](https://substack.com/redirect/52b8afda-0877-432a-9b9c-f906734c63a8?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
With grit,
Haley

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

name: LeftAction
subject: Sign: "Don’t Pay Trump’s Reflecting Pool Contractor to Screw It Up Again"
body:
We're hiring these guys AGAIN???
| | | | |
---
| | | **[Sign:"Don’t Pay Trump’s Reflecting Pool Contractor to Screw It Up Again"](https://default.salsalabs.org/T2e21d844-3578-4858-9bce-96822dede1e1/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** _**Are you F-ing kidding me? They’re using the same guys???**_ Donald Trump spent millions of taxpayer dollars giving the Lincoln Memorial Reflecting Pool a rushed vanity makeover. His administration awarded major contracts without competitive bidding, including one to a firm that had previously worked on a swimming pool at Trump’s Virginia golf course. What did America get? **[An algae bloom. Peeling material. Repeated draining. More repairs. And a massive bill that taxpayers may be forced to keep paying far into the future.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tdd1e8042-9ffd-462e-bcab-8517267b93e4/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)** But despite the algae explosion, the peeling coating and mounting questions about the project, Interior Secretary Doug Burgum says the administration intends to use the same contractor for additional repairs and will not seek new bids. [](https://default.salsalabs.org/T92a0e4e3-9daf-409f-a0c1-8798740633a5/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Seriously? When a multimillion-dollar project is followed almost immediately by green sludge, peeling material and additional repairs, the answer should not be: “Here, have some more money.” The Reflecting Pool belongs to the American people. It is not Trump’s personal decorating project, and taxpayers should not be forced to keep paying contractors with previous ties to Trump properties without independent scrutiny or competitive bidding. **[Add your name:](https://default.salsalabs.org/T28aed6dc-7e6c-4e71-a810-5d9faa8e14ad/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)**[ We demand that any non-emergency work on the Reflecting Pool be paused until there is a genuinely independent assessment of the work completed so far, and that all future repair work be subject to open, competitive bidding.](https://default.salsalabs.org/T63595f5c-20a2-457c-9d56-4a14181a7c05/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

name: Senator Vincent Hughes
subject: Storm Update and Resources
body:
Community News - Senator Vincent Hughes

*

*Storm Update and
Resources**

*We Are Monitoring Conditions Across the
District**

[image =
http://enews.senatorhughes.com//images/user_images/Hughesstorm.png]
[link 1]

Severe storms have impacted communities in our
district and throughout Philadelphia. We are actively monitoring
conditions and have been in regular contact with city officials and
utility partners.

*Mayor Parker has declared [link 2] a local
disaster emergency to support the City's recovery efforts.*

The
Office of Emergency Management, Water Department, Parks & Recreation,
Sanitation, Streets, Licenses & Inspections, and other departments
continue to respond, assess damage, and dispatch services where
needed.

*Mayor Parker is Encouraging Philadelphia to Use the
Following Resources *

*- How to Recover from a Disaster*- The
City's Blog can be found here [link 3] with safety, clean-up,
insurance, and documentation tips.

*- StormPHL Messages*- The
Office of Emergency Management has activated a dedicated text message
platform for the City to deliver storm recovery text messages to
enrollees. Those who are recovering from the storm can text "StormPHL"
to 888-777 to receive updates related to recovery.

*- Damage
Reporter Survey*- If any private property has received storm-related
damage, we ask them to complete the secure survey
(www.phila.gov/damagereporter [link 4]) for the Office of Emergency
Management. The information collected in this form will be used by the
City of Philadelphia to determine the areas and extent of
incident-related damages. This form is not an application for
resources and does not guarantee assistance; it may help determine if
assistance is available. The survey can also be completed by calling
3-1-1.

*- Downed Trees*- Should be reported to 911 if blocking a
road or on a house, reported to PECO if on electrical lines, or
reported to 3-1-1 for removal. More information can be found here
[link 5].

*- Blocked or Damaged Sewer Inlets* - Should be reported
to PWD's 24-hour emergency line at 215-685-6300.

*- 3-1-1, the
3-1-1 Mobile App*, and the Neighborhood Community Action Centers [link
6] can assist with all other city service requests.

*- 9-1-1*
should be contacted whenever an immediate life-safety or emergency
concern exists.

- We encourage everyone to Stay Informed about
severe weather threats and emergency resources by *following @philaOEM
on X and Facebook*, and by *signing up for ReadyPhiladelphia [link
7],* the City's free emergency notification system.

* We will
continue to share updates as they become available.*

[image =
http://enews.senatorhughes.com//images/user_images/StormDamage726.jpg]

Please
use caution while traveling and report storm-related hazards using the
appropriate phone numbers.

*Report Storm Damage:*

-
*Downed or damaged power lines:* *800-841-4141* [link 8] (PECO)

-
*Tree blocking a roadway or fallen on a vehicle/property:* *Call
**911* [link 9]

-
*Non-emergency questions about storm recovery:*
*Call **311* [link 10]

Stay safe and help your neighbors. We
will share more information on our social channels as we continue to
work with Mayor Parker's office and other officials to address the
damage in our communities.

footnotes
----------------------

Running ads early and launching a comprehensive organizing program is crucially important. **We need to build our general election war chest now, while momentum is with us.** Every dollar we raise sends a signal that our campaign is strong and ready for the fight ahead.

* **Worsened** Iran’s repressive regime.

body:
Sustainer Sunday story time
# [](https://francescahong.com?refcode=em20260712-3025)
Peter,
Hope everyone had a great weekend. It's time for another Sustainer Sunday, the weekly series where we share stories from Team Hong supporters. Today, we're hearing from Rebecca Zimmermann, a factory worker from Shawano who believes Wisconsin's communities should be built up for the people who live in them.
* * *
_I found Fran on my TikTok For You page. I decided to look into her more after that, and what stuck with me was the way she talks about building up Wisconsin's communities for the people, not investors._
_I do factory work in Shawano. The issues that matter most to me are our tax dollars going back into our communities, to support us and make our lives better and saying no to data centers, to save our communities and our environment._
_When I talk with someone who's undecided or skeptical about Fran, I start by asking about their own views and concerns. Most of them, I can relate to. And most of them, Fran is already addressing in her platform. Then I tell them the most important thing: She has run this entire campaign without AIPAC money, without corporate PAC money, without the billionaire donor class. She cannot be bought off._
_That's why I support Fran._
_– Rebecca Zimmermann, Shawano_
* * *
Stories like Rebecca's are the reason this campaign exists. Wisconsin's data center tax giveaway is on track to cost us more than $2 billion while utilities push rate hikes to power Big Tech's server farms.
Fran has led this fight since day one. Her [CONTROL-ALT-DELETE](http://act.francescahong.com/go/16663?t=1&akid=3025%2E105371%2E-N479o) plan is the most comprehensive data center policy in this race: a moratorium on new construction, an end to tax breaks for Big Tech, and public ownership of new energy infrastructure.
We’re just over 4 weeks days out from the August 11 primary, and everything comes down to this final push. We're up against candidates with big-money backing. This race is getting tough, but Fran is tougher.
**[Please consider giving $5, $10, $25 or more – your support has never been more important.](https://act.francescahong.com/go/1?c0=em_ms_fh_20260712.OPwJl2&refcode=em20260712-3025&t=2&akid=3025%2E105371%2E-N479o)**

With gratitude,
Team Hong
